thread:
maria: Heads-up: onboarding sampleapp observed duplicate items when we hit quick bursts + token refresh. Short log and repro below.
aj: Which SDK?
maria: JS. Default throttle window allows large bursts.
devon: Seen this before. Auth-refresh middleware replays requests; without a page-id the paginator merges identical pages.
sam: Quick fix idea: client injects X-Redwood-Page-Id per page, server or client can dedupe.
maria: Minimal patch I tested: add headers: { 'x-redwood-page-id': `${session}:${i}` } — duplicates stopped.
aj: Can we standardize this across SDKs and add a small paginator dedupe hook? Python/Go parity missing.
devon: I'll open two issues: sdk-parity for paginator dedupe + align default throttle/backoff.
ci-bot: devon opened issue #devex/1612: "paginator idempotency + SDK parity"
maria: Repro steps: 20 parallel workers, pageSize=50, expire key at t+8s to force refresh, run 60s. Capture merged results and 429s.
sam: For short-term, add a note to onboarding README and an integration test that forces mid-page token refresh.
aj: Thanks — I'll change the JS default throttle to be more conservative and add the paginator hook to the quickstart SDK sample.
